1 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.NextWedgeParameters
2 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.JunctionEdgeTransitions
3 
4 /-! The incoming wedge of an incident edge is determined by the actual
5 metric triangle. Every transition preserving the two roots carries the
6 returned wedge to this same incoming wedge, including reflected charts. -/
7 
8 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron.IncidentTriangles
9 
10 open Real Set EuclideanGeometry Wedge
11 
12 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} {a : frontier P.body} {T : P.CutLocusTree a}
13     {u v : T.vertices} {edge : T.graph.Adj u v}
14     {first_chart : P.CutVoronoiChart a (T.vertexTarget u)}
15     {second_chart : P.CutVoronoiChart a (T.vertexTarget v)} {θ φ : ℝ}
16     (D : IncidentTriangles T edge first_chart θ)
17     (E : IncidentTriangles T edge.symm second_chart φ)
18 
19 /-- The symmetric wedge for entering along this actual incident edge. -/
20 def incomingWedge (ω : ℝ) : Set Plane :=
21   {x | x - first_chart.origin ∈ polarRegion (P.surfaceDist a (T.vertexTarget u)) ω
22     (θ - angle D.model.first D.model.left D.model.right)
23     (θ + angle D.model.first D.model.left D.model.right)}
24 
25 /-- Triangle corner agreement identifies the entire returned wedge across
26 an edge. This works for the same motion that aligns the full triangle maps. -/
27 theorem next_wedge_image (motion : Plane ≃ᵃⁱ[ℝ] Plane)
28     (old_root : motion first_chart.origin =
29       second_chart.origin + dist (v : Space) (u : Space) • direction φ)
30     (next_root : motion (first_chart.origin + dist (u : Space) (v : Space) • direction θ) =
31       second_chart.origin)
32     {radius Θ : ℝ} (radius_eq : radius = P.surfaceDist a (T.vertexTarget v))
33     (corner_eq : π - Θ = angle D.model.first D.model.right D.model.left) (ω : ℝ) :
34     motion '' {x | x - (first_chart.origin + dist (u : Space) (v : Space) • direction θ) ∈
35       polarRegion radius ω (Θ + θ) (2 * π - Θ + θ)} = E.incomingWedge ω := by
36   have length_positive : 0 < dist (u : Space) (v : Space) := by
37     apply dist_pos.mpr
38     intro same
39     exact edge.ne (Subtype.ext same)
40   have half : π - Θ = angle E.model.first E.model.left E.model.right :=
41     corner_eq.trans (D.model.reverse_angles E.model).2.2
42   have on_axis : motion ((first_chart.origin + dist (u : Space) (v : Space) • direction θ) +
43       dist (u : Space) (v : Space) • direction (θ + π)) =
44         second_chart.origin + dist (u : Space) (v : Space) • direction φ := by
45     rw [next_root_back_ray, old_root, dist_comm (v : Space) (u : Space)]
46   have result := centered_wedge_image motion
47     (first_chart.origin + dist (u : Space) (v : Space) • direction θ) second_chart.origin
48     length_positive next_root on_axis radius ω (π - Θ)
49   rw [show θ + π - (π - Θ) = Θ + θ by ring,
50     show θ + π + (π - Θ) = 2 * π - Θ + θ by ring, radius_eq, half] at result
51   simpa only [radius_eq, incomingWedge] using result
52 
53 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron.IncidentTriangles
